findings.finding: Teaching others helps learners refine their own understanding and grasp of the material.
findings.quote: The educational principle Lernen durch Lehren (LdL), or Learning by Teaching, has long been recognized for its ability to deepen the understanding of students through the act of teaching others.

findings.finding: Explaining a concept to an inanimate object can help a learner identify gaps in their own knowledge.
findings.quote: This technique is based on evidence that show that teaching an inanimate object improves understanding and knowledge retention of a subject.

findings.finding: When a learner cannot explain a concept clearly, it signals that they need to revisit and research the topic further.
findings.quote: When the writer reaches an area which they are unable to comfortably explain, they go back and re-read or research the topic until they are able to do so.

principle: The act of teaching material to others or explaining it to an object deepens the learner's own understanding and improves their knowledge retention.
for_the_teacher: Ask the learner to explain the dance step or movement back to the camera as if they were teaching a beginner.
Encourage the learner to practice by explaining the movement out loud to an inanimate object in their room.
If a learner struggles to explain a movement, prompt them to re-watch the demonstration video to clarify their understanding.
